name: Kamuvi
summary:
Experience Kabyle music like never before in Virtual Reality.

KaMuVi (Kabyle Music Visualizer) is an immersive VR experience designed to celebrate the rich Amazigh musical and cultural heritage. Immerse yourself in a breathtaking nightscape atop the snow-capped Djurdjura Mountains, illuminated by the moon and a starry sky.

Whether listening to the legendary masterpieces of Idir, the committed poetry of Matoub Lounès, the modern sounds of Ali Amrane, or playing your own tracks and voice, KaMuVi
